route.name: Hosshinmon-oji to Kumano Hongu Taisha then Oyunohara
route.walking_time: 2-3 hours (official baseline; allow at least 3.5h with stamps, photos and visits)

gpx_contains: 10 stamp location waypoints only; no route track geometry
coordinate_caveat: Coordinates are representative landmark locations and do not guarantee the exact physical stamp stand location.

points.name: 發心門王子
points.note: 第 1 顆章；起登點，先在此確認印章台。
points.coordinate_source: National Institute of Japanese Literature / Geoshape, Historic Place Name data
points.coordinate_confidence: 高（資料集列出該歷史地點座標；印章台可能與代表點有數公尺差異）

points.name: 水吞王子

points.name: 伏拜王子

points.coordinate_confidence: 高（地方開放資料座標；印章台位置可能調整）

points.name: 熊野本宮大社

points.coordinate_confidence: 高（地方開放資料座標；院內印章位置以現場為準）
